title: Marketing CDK stack: bucket, distribution, /api* behavior, OIDC role

comments.author: home
comments.text:
CDK app in Chattic.us-web: S3 bucket, CloudFront distribution for chattic.us,
an /api* behavior pointing at the same thin-turn Lambda function URL with the
same X-Chatticus-Invoke-Key header pattern as infra/lib/web-stack.ts here, so
waitlist and contact posts stay same-origin with no code change to
lib/config.ts's apiBase. Reads the invoke secret from Secrets Manager in the
shared account. Issues its own ACM certificate for chattic.us + www.chattic.us,
DNS-validated against the existing hosted zone (which stays in this repo's
infra/lib/dns-stack.ts). New GitHub OIDC deploy role scoped to Chattic.us-web,
mirroring infra/lib/github-deploy-stack.ts.

Production only, per the answered question on this epic.
